THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

This writ petition is filed seeking for following relief:-
"Issue a writ of mandamus, writ or direction directing the respondents to pay the compensation amount for usage of the land belong to petitioners in Sy.No.283/P,
portion, situated at Bommarabettu Village, Udupi Taluk and District for widening the public road (PWD Road) from Hiriadka to Karkala and to pay the same by adopting proper procedures under the Land Acquisition Act."

2. Shri S.K. Acharya, learned counsel for petitioners submitted that in terms of order dated 23.06.2023, this Court had directed both parties to explore settlement through Mediation before Mediation Centre, Udupi and appointed Shri Sarvodaya Shettigar, Retired Distrit Judge as Mediator.
It is submitted that upon parties appearing before Mediator, a settlement was arrived at and report from District Legal Services Authority, Udupi, was received.
4. To find out about further steps taken in terms of settlement, Executive Engineer PWD-respondent no.2 was directed to be present before Court.
In terms of order dated 22.11.2023, Executive Engineer, PWD, is present before Court.

5. Learned AGA on instructions would submit that settlement arrived at between parties before Mediator at Udupi on 04.09.2023 has received approval in principle from Finance Department of Government of Karnataka and respondent would make payment in terms of settlement, upon petitioner executing sale deed in favour of respondent no.2 in respect of schedule property.

entities.text: Finance Department of Government of Karnataka
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 6. In response, learned counsel for petitioners submitted that petitioners would be ready to execute sale deed on any date stipulated.

In view of above developments this writ petition can be disposed of by fixing date for petitioners to appear before Sub-Registrar, Udupi, to execute sale deed in respect of schedule property in favour of respondents and directing respondents to make payment of sale consideration as agreed before Mediator.
8. Accordingly, writ petition is disposed of.
Petitioners to appear before Sub-Registrar, Udupi on 22.01.2024 for execution of sale deed in favour of respondents.

Respondent no.2 to have sale deed executed and make payment of sale consideration of Rs.3,45,000/- per cent of land in respect of 20 Jalaja Shetty vs State Of Karnataka on 11 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75070084/
3 cents of land in Sy.No.283/P6 of Bommarabettu Village, Udupi Taluk and District, as per settlement within one week thereafter.
